title: Authority map: SIP, Relationship CRM, Odoo and intentions
summary: SIP owns signalling/media evidence; Relationship CRM owns business relationship and interaction semantics; Odoo is a provider/backing system; intention discovery advertises capability but never inherits mutation authority.
invariants: SIP Call-ID, From/To, direction, signalling result and media remain SIP authority.
Relationship CRM owns RelationshipRecord, RelationshipInteractionRef and RelationshipCommunication semantics.
Odoo res.partner/crm.lead/mail.message objects are provider evidence and backing objects, not replacements for Relationship CRM authority.
Native Odoo discuss.call.history and RTC objects must not be fabricated for external SIP calls.
Management/Intention discovery is read-only capability discovery and does not acquire provider credentials or mutation authority.
procedure: Resolve caller identity through the Odoo provider only after local discovery policy admits the model/operation.
Project provider evidence into canonical Relationship CRM objects before crossing the CRM service boundary.
Retain original SIP or Interaction Event identity as correlation/causation evidence.

provenance.claim: current Odoo provider architecture and adapters
canonical Relationship CRM domain object model
current SIP delivery inspected for authority and UAC capability
